_comment: Golden design constants. See golden/README.md for the naming convention and CLAUDE.md 'Golden designs' for how this fits the project. Do not hand-edit numbers here without re-running the CLI and re-deriving them.

launch.description: Real Taoglas EMPCB.SMAFSTJ.B.HT SMA (with_sma=True) + its 4 discrete coplanar ground-leg pads and stitching vias (gnd_stitch=True). This is PAD-ONLY ground stitching (cpwg_gap_mm=None in topologies/dualmode.py's TAOGLAS_SMA) -- NOT the impedance-matched CPWG gap. Do not tag this 'cpwg_taoglas': that name is reserved for a run that actually used cpwg_gap_mm (the gap-matched launch cascade now defaults to, and which a separate 0-8GHz check of this same geometry confirmed still stays well-matched, but which was NOT what produced the metrics below -- see docs/TUNING_PLAN_2026-08-29.md sec 2 and output/data/v20_dualmode_broadband.npz).

known_open_item: Bandwidth 318 MHz vs the 143.5 MHz (5% FBW) target -- not yet fixed. Needs a Qe(w_ext)/k12 recalibration for this topology the same way cascade's was done, not a black-box search (see CLAUDE.md sec 6/10b).

provenance.confirms: re-run 2026-08-31 via the CLI (compare-baselines' fine confirm, now persisted end-to-end) reproduces the original 2026-08-24 opt_dualmode_best.json numbers to <0.02dB / <1MHz -- score differs (9.69 vs 9.31) only because score() gained hinge terms since (CLAUDE.md sec 4 v18 objective), not because the design changed.
